known_condition.statement: A bar that shells out to the emitter is green only on a committed tree. A dirty tree makes the Maker's own work unmeasurable and the failures read as capability failures.
known_condition.measured: measured 2026-11-08 on this job: after the one-generation Maker run, D4 (record_check_time_comes_from_the_log) and D5 (record_names_the_log_path) reported red with 'the emitter's tree is dirty ... a record must name code that exists as a commit' -- not a capability failure. Committed, the same bar was 12/12.
known_condition.recurrence: This WILL recur on every emitter-facing job.
known_condition.rule_for_the_next_job: Before measuring any emitter-facing bar, make the tree clean: commit the Maker's work as an explicit Orchestrator commit whose message says so, or measure in a throwaway clone. Never report a dirty-tree refusal as a capability failure.
known_condition.where_it_lives: RECORD-LEVEL ONLY. It is NOT in the repo. AGENTS.md is a protected agent-instruction file and the write was refused without owner approval; schemas/instance-extensions.json holds no known-conditions block. Until the Owner approves an AGENTS.md edit, this record is the only home for the condition.

orchestrator_commit.what: an Orchestrator commit of the MAKER's work, made to measure. The Orchestrator authored no code. The commit message says 'WIP: evaluator harness log, found by the Orchestrator on measuring a dirty tree' so no reader mistakes it for Maker authorship.
orchestrator_commit.why: the emitter refuses to write a record on a dirty tree, so the bar could not be measured uncommitted
